title: No unwrap() or expect() on fallible operations
context: Need to prevent runtime panics from filesystem, process, or user-input operations.
decision: Rust: No unwrap() or expect() on anything depending on filesystem, process, or user input. Only acceptable for genuine invariants (regex literals, owned mutexes) with explanatory comments.
consequences: Lock-poisoning—the one invariant shipping code leans on—answered once in src-tauri/src/sync.rs and crates/kaava-rpc/src/sync.rs rather than at each of 40 call sites. Enforced by clippy::unwrap_used and clippy::expect_used (tests exempted wholesale).
